hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A launch-platform hook for tokenized stocks that charges a fixed per-pool swap fee (0–5%, set at launch), splits it 80/5/15 between creator, bid-wall, and platform, and automatically places a single-sided quote-token liquidity range one tick spacing below spot using the wall share. Liquidity additions are restricted to the factory and the hook itself until the pool graduates past a configurable price threshold.
